ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious MacOS Firmware Activity
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when a user manipulates with Firmward Password on MacOS. NOTE - this command has been disabled on silicon-based apple computers.

sequences.query: (process_path = "\/usr\/sbin\/firmwarepasswd" AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*setpasswd.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*full.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*delete.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*check.*")))
